title: Sources: England and Wales' attorney general tells his office to stop posting on X, a first for the UK government, amid worries about X inciting violence (Peter Walker/The Guardian)
summary: Peter Walker / The Guardian: Sources: England and Wales' attorney general tells his office to stop posting on X, a first for the UK government, amid worries about X inciting violence — Exclusive: Richard Hermer's office understood to be first in government to restrict use after recent riots
